messages:
liam: heads up — invoice previews show negative burst credits for a handful of EU tenants since 22:00 UTC. Not a full delta, looks like route tags flipped to 'debug' and got double-counted.
sarah: re: which workflow? ingest or tally?
liam: looks like ingest-side enrichment. I pulled a sample event: ```{"tenant_id":"acct_123","route_tag":"debug","tokens":42,"phase":"ingest.enrich","fingerprint":"fp_abc"}``` we have an extra attribution path in the enrich sidecar that's appending a second charge line.
kai: omg that JSON shape matches the new route-resolver patch from yesterday. @sarah can you check the enrich join keys? maybe a leftover fallback we pushed.
sarah: looking now. running quick query: `select count(*) from events where phase='ingest.enrich' and route_tag='debug' and billing_flag=true` — gives ~8k rows in last hour, only ~150 expected.
nadia: ingested a small repro from liam into staging, getting duplicates on replay.
ingest-bot: duplicate_event_warning detected 2 events with same fingerprint for acct_123 within 5s. tag=debug :warning:
liam: possible cause: route-resolver returns both legacy route_id and new route_hint when it can't map. Tally later coalesces by fingerprint _or_ route, but our preview pipeline coalesces by fingerprint only if route is missing. so duplicate when both present.
kai: proposed quick fix — canonicalize route field in enrich to prefer route_hint and drop legacy route_id until rollout completes. low-risk rollback.
sarah: agree. I'll open a hotfix PR and a short canary rollout to EU only. Also adding an alert threshold to console: "preview delta > 1% of expected credits" so we catch this earlier.
liam: also adding a telemetry tag `route_resolution_version` to invoice events so we can A/B trace. will follow up with a small eval to confirm no invoice break.
nadia: replays in staging fixed after canonicalization. will coordinate a 30m canary at 23:15 UTC and watch preview anomalies + dashboard spike.
kai: ping if you need me to flip the feature flag. thanks all :thumbsup: 
ingest-bot: canary_deploy started env=staging component=route-resolver user=sarah
